name: Borja Giménez Larraz - Après le § 42 - Am 16
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: 42a. Calls for the EU’s current economic governance framework and its instruments to be rescinded, since it imposes budgetary restrictions that constrain public investment, including in social functions performed by the state, particularly in public housing policy;
